name: Kabayo Muhau
bio: Founder of Donmac in 2011 and Group Managing Director, leading group strategy, key client relationships and project delivery across all four business divisions.
messageTitle: Building the infrastructure of a sustainable Zambia.
message: When we started Donmac in 2011, we believed something simple. Zambia had enormous solar potential, a growing appetite for electric mobility and an ICT sector that was barely touched. More than a decade on, that belief is exactly what drives this company every day.

We began as a focused supplier and we have grown into a diversified group. Today mining companies, government institutions, universities and councils trust us to deliver work that actually performs on site, and not only on paper. Every solar plant we switch on, every system we connect and every vehicle we help put on the road is built to create real, lasting value.

What we promise our clients, partners and investors is consistency. We hold ourselves to high engineering standards, we govern the business openly and we stay close to the communities we serve. As Zambia and the wider region move toward a cleaner and better connected future, we intend to be out in front, doing the work.
I would be glad to have you join us on this journey.
